description: The Canton of Vaud's energy authority maintains a cadastre of heat-production plants supplying district-heating networks. Listed attributes include nominal power, delivered energy, consumed energy resources and the name of the supplied network. The inventory draws on an annual survey and follows an extended version of the federal thermal-network data model. Coverage is canton-wide. Its definition requires a main distribution network using public land and heat sold to third parties; shared heating communities and systems serving a single parcel are excluded. The metadata list Esri geodatabase, GeoPackage and Interlis 2 downloads, a WMS layer and CH1903+ coordinates. Provider conditions are linked as DCG 8401. Cost is unknown, and a limitation is that operational access was not independently established, and no data file was retrieved. The attributes provide plant-capacity and heat-supply inputs for network planning; empirical accuracy remains untested. Related Vaud records describe building-energy estimates and a 2035 heat-supply scenario. Viageo's public demo label leaves production availability unresolved.
